name: Vee
source:
"It's a heretic's DESTINY.... to be dragged to HELL..."
Around 20 years old. A believer in Kingdoms only religion "Moschino" and the leader of the Assassination Unit.
He has a ridiculously above average jumping power and fitting of an assassin he excels at hiding his presence.

[spoiler]His real name is Ham al Fut.[/spoiler]
